verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://glama.ai/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured summary of the directory, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. Beyond that the agent-oriented surface is thin: the markdown doc variant (mcp.md) and every OpenAPI candidate path return 404. One community report says the user's AI agent could not find answers in the documentation, which suggests limited depth but does not contradict the llms.txt itself. Missing for 10: markdown/agent-readable versions of doc pages, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration that agents can effectively use llms.txt.
